title: ci.begun event data
description: qa ci begin compared the .qa/config.json a CI job checked out (found) with the hash its workflow carries (expected). From this event on the workspace is CI-pinned. When they match, config.accepted with basis ci-pin follows; when they do not, nothing is accepted, so every later run but static analysis is blocked with config_drift. runner holds only the allowlisted GITHUB_* values that are well formed. authority_mac is the machine-bound MAC ledger.append adds; an event without a valid one confers no authority.
